description: Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10323804 bytes are kept.

d.request: For tracks with `Track.Bytes > 10323804` that match a media type, group by `MediaType.Name` and return the name, the unrounded average `Track.UnitPrice`, the unrounded average `Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds`, and that last average divided by the unrounded, unweighted average of those per-media-type averages; ignore missing values in all averages, return missing averages where no values qualify, and return no rows if the across-media-type average is missing.
d.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId AND t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_of_averages FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.Name, ma.average_unit_price, ma.average_bytes_per_millisecond, ma.average_bytes_per_millisecond / o.average_of_averages AS relative_average FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_of_averages IS NOT NULL

c.request: Joining each track to its media type (dropping tracks with no matching media type) and using 10323804 bytes as the file-size threshold (`Track.Bytes`) to keep only the large files, for each media type name (`MediaType.Name`) give the media type name, the average list price per track (`Track.UnitPrice`), and the average of file size divided by track length (`Track.Bytes` ÷ `Track.Milliseconds`). Also give that last average divided by the plain average of it across all the media types. All averages should ignore missing values and be missing when there are none. Return no rows if the across-media-type average is missing. Leave all values unrounded. Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10323804 bytes are kept.
c.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_list_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_across_media_types FROM media_averages) SELECT media_type_name, average_list_price, average_bytes_per_millisecond, average_bytes_per_millisecond / average_across_media_types AS relative_average FROM media_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_across_media_types IS NOT NULL

b.request: For each media type name, include tracks with a matching media type and `Track.Bytes > 10323804`; return the name, the unrounded average `Track.UnitPrice`, the unrounded average `Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds`, and that last average divided by the unrounded, equally weighted average of the per-media-type averages. Ignore missing values in each average, return a missing average when it has no values, and return no rows if the across-media-type average is missing.
b.sql: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT m.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId AND t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_of_averages FROM per_media_type) SELECT p.Name, p.average_unit_price, p.average_bytes_per_millisecond, p.average_bytes_per_millisecond / o.average_of_averages AS relative_average FROM per_media_type AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_of_averages IS NOT NULL;

Ignore missing values in each average, return a missing average when it has no values, and return no rows if the across-media-type average is missing.

a.request: Joining each track to its media type (dropping tracks with no matching media type) and keeping only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is more than 10323804 bytes, for each media type name (`MediaType.Name`) give the media type name, the average list price per track (`Track.UnitPrice`), and the average of file size divided by track length (`Track.Bytes` ÷ `Track.Milliseconds`). Also give that last average divided by the plain average of it across all the media types. All averages should ignore missing values and be missing when there are none. Return no rows if the across-media-type average is missing. Leave all values unrounded.
a.sql: WITH media_type_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_list_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_across_media_types FROM media_type_averages) SELECT a.media_type_name, a.average_list_price, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond / o.average_across_media_types AS relative_average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM media_type_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_across_media_types IS NOT NULL
